# ClawTool AI — clawtool.ai

**ClawTool AI** is the single-product tool of the Claw AI family: paste any email thread, meeting transcript or document, and it claws out the action items — task, owner, deadline, priority — then syncs them to Todoist, Notion, Slack or email.

## Product
- Claw anything: email, transcripts, PDFs, notes, Slack exports
- Smart extraction with owner, deadline and confidence per item
- Priority scoring (deadline, who's waiting, frequency)
- Sync: Todoist, Notion, Slack, email digest, Markdown copy
- Zero-retention by default, EU processing, never trains shared models
- Team claws: shared threads, per-owner views

## Pricing (EUR)
| Plan | Price | Includes |
|---|---|---|
| Free | €0 | 10 claws/day, 50 pages each, email digest, zero-retention |
| Pro | €19/mo | unlimited claws & length, all syncs, 90-day opt-in history, priority processing |
| Team | €49/mo | 5 seats, shared threads, admin controls + audit log, Google SSO |
